cohort: Women who delivered with singleton pregnancies over 20 weeks gestation at three public hospitals in Western Sydney, Australia
finding: Despite a low prevalence of COVID-19, both positive and adverse obstetric outcomes were observed that may be related to changes in service delivery and interaction with healthcare providers.
mod_finding: During the COVID-19 period, there was no change for induction of labour but a 25% increase in caesarean section births (aOR 1.25; 95% CI 1.19 to 1.32, p<0.001).
